<html lang="es-CO">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0">
<title>Lima Eléctrica para Pies TROGÜI — Adiós Callos y Talones Ásperos | Envío Gratis</title>
<meta name="description" content="Lima Eléctrica para Pies TROGÜI: elimina callos y piel áspera desde casa. 2 velocidades, luz LED, recargable USB. Pago contra entrega, envío gratis a toda Colombia.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><rect width=%22100%22 height=%22100%22 rx=%2220%22 fill=%22%23ff6a00%22/><text x=%2250%22 y=%2266%22 font-size=%2255%22 font-family=%22Arial%22 font-weight=%22900%22 fill=%22white%22 text-anchor=%22middle%22>T</text></svg>">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --black:#18120f; --cream:#fff9f5; --white:#fff;
  --orange:#ff6a00; --orange-dark:#e25a00; --orange-light:#ff9a52;
  --pink:#ffb4a8; --pink-soft:#fff0ed;
  --green:#25d366; --gray:#7a6f68; --gray-light:#f0e6e0;
  --radius:18px; --shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(30,15,5,.10);
  font-size:16px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
body{
  font-family:'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;
  background:var(--cream); color:var(--black); -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;}
.icon{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;display:inline-block;vertical-align:-4px;}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease;}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px;}

/* HEADER */
header.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(255,249,245,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-light);}
.header-inner{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;}
.logo{font-weight:900;font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--black);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;}
.logo .accent{color:var(--orange);}
.logo small{display:block;font-size:.52rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:-2px;}
.header-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.btn-ghost{border:1.5px solid var(--black);color:var(--black);font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;}
.btn-wsp{background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:34px 0 26px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--pink-soft) 0%,var(--cream) 55%);}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-100px;right:-100px;width:320px;height:320px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,106,0,.18),transparent 70%);animation:float1 7s ease-in-out infinite;}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-80px;left:-80px;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,180,168,.35),transparent 70%);animation:float2 8s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translateY(18px) scale(1.06);}}
@keyframes float2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(1.05);}}
.hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;}
@media (max-width:820px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;}}
.hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--orange-dark);margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04);}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4.4vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 12px;}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--orange-dark);}
.hero p.sub{font-size:1rem;color:#4a423d;max-width:460px;margin:0 0 20px;line-height:1.5;}
.hero-cta{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;
  padding:16px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-size:1rem;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(255,106,0,.4);
  animation:heroShake 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes heroShake{0%,84%{transform:scale(1);}87%{transform:scale(1.035) rotate(-1deg);}90%{transform:scale(1.035) rotate(1deg);}93%{transform:scale(1.02) rotate(0);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}
.hero-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:18px;}
.hero-trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#4a423d;}
.hero-trust .icon{color:var(--orange-dark);}
.hero-img-wrap{position:relative;}
.hero-img-card{
  border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(30,15,5,.18);position:relative;
  animation:heroImgIn 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
@keyframes heroImgIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) scale(.96);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}}
.hero-img-card img{width:100%;display:block;}
.hero-shine{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 45%,transparent 60%);background-size:250% 250%;animation:shineMove 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;}
@keyframes shineMove{0%{background-position:200% 0;}100%{background-position:-50% 0;}}
.hero-price-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hero-price-old{font-size:1.05rem;color:#a89f98;text-decoration:line-through;}
.hero-price-now{font-size:2rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.hero-price-tag{background:#e0392b;color:#fff;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;}
.hero-flag{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:#fff;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--orange-dark);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}

/* NOTIFICACIONES SOCIALES */
.notif-host{position:fixed;bottom:90px;left:14px;z-index:85;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-width:250px;}
.notif-toast{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-left:3px solid var(--orange);border-radius:12px;
  padding:10px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;color:#333;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.14);opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .3s, transform .3s;
}
.notif-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.notif-avatar{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;}
@media (max-width:760px){ .notif-host{bottom:88px;left:10px;max-width:210px;} }

/* CARRIERS EN FORMULARIO */
.carriers-form-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--pink-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:14px;}
.carriers-form-note img{width:44px;height:auto;border-radius:6px;flex:none;}
.carriers-form-note span{font-size:.76rem;color:#5c534d;font-weight:600;}

/* VIDEO AUTOPLAY (gif) */
.video-auto-card{position:relative;max-width:300px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.video-auto-card img{width:100%;display:block;}
.video-live-badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:#e0392b;color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.video-live-badge .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:blinkDot 1.2s infinite;}
@keyframes blinkDot{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:.3;}}
.video-expand-btn{display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:12px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--orange-dark);}

/* URGENCY BAR */
.urgency-bar{background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;}
.urgency-inner{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px 16px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;}
.urgency-inner .fire{color:var(--orange-light);}
.urgency-timer{display:flex;gap:5px;}
.urgency-timer b{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:5px 9px;border-radius:8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:36px;text-align:center;}

/* SECTION HEADS */
.sec{padding:52px 0;}
.sec-head{text-align:center;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 34px;}
.sec-eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange-dark);background:var(--pink-soft);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3.2vw,2rem);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.25;}
.sec-head p{color:#5c534d;font-size:.95rem;margin:0;}

/* PROBLEMA */
.problema-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;}
@media (max-width:760px){.problema-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.problem-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.problem-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
.problem-card .x{color:#e0392b;font-weight:900;flex:none;}
.problema-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.problema-quote{margin-top:16px;font-size:.92rem;color:#4a423d;line-height:1.6;font-style:italic;border-left:3px solid var(--orange);padding-left:14px;}

/* TRANSFORMACION */
.transform-wrap{text-align:center;}
.transform-img{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.transform-caption{margin-top:16px;color:#4a423d;font-size:.92rem;max-width:480px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

/* PRODUCTO */
.producto-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;}
@media (max-width:820px){.producto-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.producto-img-wrap{position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.tag-float{
  position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800;
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.14);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(10px) scale(.8);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease;pointer-events:none;
}
.tag-float.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}
.producto-img-wrap{transition:transform .15s ease-out;transform-style:preserve-3d;will-change:transform;}

/* Stagger reveal delays for grouped items */
.problem-cards .problem-card:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.05s;}
.problem-cards .problem-card:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.12s;}
.problem-cards .problem-card:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.19s;}
.problem-cards .problem-card:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.26s;}
.problem-cards .problem-card:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.33s;}
.feature-list li{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-16px);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease;}
.feature-list.in li{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.05s;}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.13s;}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.21s;}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.29s;}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.37s;}
.feature-list.in li:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.45s;}
.steps-grid .step-card:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.05s;}
.steps-grid .step-card:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.18s;}
.steps-grid .step-card:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.31s;}
.rev-grid .rev-card:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.05s;}
.rev-grid .rev-card:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.15s;}
.rev-grid .rev-card:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.25s;}
.oferta-cards .oferta-card:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.15s;}
.step-card{transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease,box-shadow .25s;}
.step-card:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.1);transform:translateY(-4px);}
.oferta-card{transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .35s ease,box-shadow .25s;}
.oferta-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.015);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.16);}
.rev-card{transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .35s ease,box-shadow .25s;}
.rev-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}

/* Header shrink on scroll */
.site-header{transition:padding .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;}
.site-header.scrolled{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.site-header.scrolled .header-inner{padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px;}

/* Trust ticker */
.trust-ticker{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-light);padding:9px 0;overflow:hidden;}
.trust-ticker-track{display:flex;gap:40px;white-space:nowrap;width:max-content;animation:tickerScroll 22s linear infinite;}
@keyframes tickerScroll{0%{transform:translateX(0);}100%{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
.trust-ticker-track span{font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;color:#5c534d;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.trust-ticker-track span b{color:var(--orange-dark);}

/* Count-up number wrapper */
.count-num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.feature-list{list-style:none;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.feature-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;color:#3a332f;}
.feature-ico{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--pink-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.includes-box{margin-top:22px;background:#fff;border:1px dashed var(--orange);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;}
.includes-box b{display:block;font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--orange-dark);margin-bottom:8px;}
.includes-box ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:.86rem;color:#4a423d;line-height:1.7;}

/* COMO FUNCIONA */
.steps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;}
@media (max-width:760px){.steps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.step-card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
.step-num{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:1.1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px;}
.step-card h3{font-size:.98rem;margin:0 0 8px;}
.step-card p{font-size:.84rem;color:#5c534d;margin:0;line-height:1.5;}

/* VIDEO */
.video-card{position:relative;max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;aspect-ratio:9/13;}
.video-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.video-play{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.video-play-btn{
  width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);animation:pulseRing 2s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0);}}
.video-play-btn svg{width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--orange-dark);margin-left:3px;}

/* TESTIMONIOS */
.rev-note{text-align:center;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--gray);max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 22px;background:var(--pink-soft);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:12px;}
.rev-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;}
.rev-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);}
.rev-stars{color:#ffb400;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
.rev-text{font-size:.86rem;color:#3a332f;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:10px;}
.rev-tag{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--orange-dark);background:var(--pink-soft);display:inline-block;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;}

/* OFERTA */
.oferta-sec{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--black) 0%,#2a1a10 100%);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.oferta-sec::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-80px;right:-80px;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,106,0,.35),transparent 70%);animation:float1 6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.oferta-sec .sec-head h2{color:#fff;}
.oferta-sec .sec-head p{color:#d8cfc8;}
.oferta-sec .sec-eyebrow{background:rgba(255,106,0,.18);color:var(--orange-light);}
.oferta-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
@media (max-width:700px){.oferta-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.oferta-card{
  background:#fff;color:var(--black);border-radius:20px;padding:26px 22px;text-align:center;position:relative;
  border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .2s;
}
.oferta-card.best{border-color:var(--orange);}
.oferta-card .ribbon{
  position:absolute;top:-13px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--orange);color:#fff;
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.oferta-card h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 12px;color:#5c534d;}
.oferta-price-old{color:#a89f98;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:.95rem;}
.oferta-price-now{font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--orange-dark);margin:2px 0 4px;}
.oferta-save{font-size:.78rem;color:#1a8a4a;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;}
.oferta-buy{
  width:100%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;padding:13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.92rem;
  animation:heroShake 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* FORMULARIO */
.form-card{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:26px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;}
.form-row{margin-bottom:13px;}
.form-row label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;color:#333;}
.form-row input,.form-row select,.form-row textarea{
  width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:10px;font-size:.89rem;font-family:inherit;outline:none;
}
.form-row input:focus,.form-row select:focus,.form-row textarea:focus{border-color:var(--orange);}
.pkg-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.pkg-opt{flex:1;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 10px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}
.pkg-opt.checked{border-color:var(--orange);background:var(--pink-soft);}
.pkg-opt b{display:block;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.pkg-opt span{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gray);}
.radio-group{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.radio-opt{flex:1;min-width:140px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;}
.radio-opt input{width:auto;}
.radio-opt.checked{border-color:var(--orange);background:var(--pink-soft);}
.form-submit{width:100%;padding:15px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:800;border-radius:12px;font-size:.95rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;}
.form-submit:disabled{opacity:.6;}
.form-trust{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;font-size:.78rem;color:#5c534d;}
.form-trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}

/* GARANTIA */
.garantia-box{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:32px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.garantia-shield{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--orange-dark);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px;animation:shieldPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes shieldPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.08);}}
.garantia-shield svg{width:32px;height:32px;}

/* FAQ */
.faq-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;}
.faq-q{padding:16px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;}
.faq-q .plus{transition:transform .25s;color:var(--orange-dark);font-size:1.2rem;}
.faq-item.open .plus{transform:rotate(45deg);}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease;font-size:.86rem;color:#4a423d;line-height:1.55;}
.faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:200px;}
.faq-a-inner{padding:0 18px 16px;}

/* CTA FINAL */
.cta-final{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink-soft),var(--cream));text-align:center;}
.cta-final h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3.4vw,2.1rem);margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:800;}
.cta-final p{color:#4a423d;margin:0 0 22px;}

/* STICKY BOTTOM CTA (mobile) */
.sticky-cta{display:none;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:90;background:#fff;padding:10px 14px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-shadow:0 -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.sticky-cta-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;}
.sticky-cta-price{font-weight:900;color:var(--orange-dark);font-size:1rem;white-space:nowrap;}
.sticky-cta-btn{flex:1;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;padding:13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.88rem;text-align:center;animation:heroShake 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
@media (max-width:760px){ .sticky-cta{display:block;} body{padding-bottom:76px;} }

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--black);color:#cfc6c0;padding:34px 18px 90px;text-align:center;}
footer .flogo{font-weight:900;font-size:1.2rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
footer .flogo span{color:var(--orange);}
footer p{font-size:.78rem;margin:4px 0;}
footer a{color:#e2a97e;}
@media (min-width:761px){ footer{padding-bottom:34px;} }

/* Panel icons (P / R) */
.mini-fab{position:fixed;bottom:20px;z-index:85;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,20,15,.1);color:rgba(20,20,15,.35);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.mini-fab.r{left:14px;}
.mini-fab.p{left:46px;}
@media (max-width:760px){ .mini-fab{bottom:82px;} }

/* MODALS (reutilizados) */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,10,8,.55);z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;backdrop-filter:blur(2px);}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;max-width:480px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:22px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
.modal.wide{max-width:760px;}
.modal-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#f2f1ec;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;color:#333;}
.modal h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.1rem;}
.modal .sub{color:var(--gray);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:16px;}
.video-modal-inner{border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;}
.video-modal-inner video{width:100%;display:block;}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;z-index:300;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;}
.toast.show{opacity:1;}
.order-card{border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#fff;}
.order-card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.order-line{font-size:.8rem;color:#333;margin-bottom:3px;line-height:1.4;}
.order-status{display:inline-block;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;}
.order-status.pendiente{background:#fff4ea;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.order-status.resuelto{background:#e6f3ff;color:#1a5aa8;}
.order-status.entregado{background:#e9f9ee;color:#1a8a4a;}
.order-status.cancelado{background:#fbe9e7;color:#c0392b;}
.order-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.order-actions button{font-size:.68rem;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;background:#f2f1ec;color:#333;}
.order-actions button.active{background:var(--black);color:#fff;}
.orders-summary{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.orders-summary .pill{background:#f7f6f2;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;color:#333;}
.orders-empty{text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--gray);font-size:.85rem;}
</style>
</head>

      <span><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg> Pago contra entrega</span>
      <span><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2 4 5v6c0 5 3.5 9 8 11 4.5-2 8-6 8-11V5z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg> 30 días de garantía</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="flogo">TR<span>O</span>GÜI</div>

</footer>

<div class="sticky-cta">
  <div class="sticky-cta-inner">
    <div class="sticky-cta-price" id="stickyPrice">$49.000</div>
    <a href="#formulario" class="sticky-cta-btn">🛒 Comprar ahora</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mini-fab r" onclick="openAdminLogin()" title="Panel">R</div>
<div class="mini-fab p" onclick="openOrdersLogin()" title="Pedidos">P</div>
<div id="notifHost" class="notif-host"></div>
<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>

<script>
/* ================= CONFIG ================= */
const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = '573206572598';
const PRICE = 49000;
const OLD_PRICE = 89000;
const BUNDLE_PRICE = 69900;
const BUNDLE_OLD_PRICE = 178000;
const PRODUCT_NAME = 'Lima Eléctrica para Pies Trogüi';
const PRODUCT_ID = 'PIES-LIMA-01';
const ADMIN_PASS = '4325';
const ORDERS_PASSWORD = '3214';
const ORDERS_STORAGE_KEY = 'trogui_pies_orders_v1';
const GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwvEih0Rz1ILAVLiUywaDBCXuOVFggogxNBtkoIp5Rwp9aKVM-pd5IQ56t31dpwezk/exec';
const CIUDADES_PRINCIPALES = ['bogota','medellin','cali','barranquilla','cartagena','bucaramanga','pereira',
'manizales','ibague','cucuta','santa marta','villavicencio','monteria','neiva','armenia','pasto','popayan',
'sincelejo','valledupar','soacha','envigado','itagui','bello','soledad','floridablanca','dosquebradas',
'palmira','buenaventura','tulua','rionegro','chia','girardot','yopal','tunja','riohacha','quibdo','sogamoso'];

function money(n){ return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('es-CO'); }
function normalizeTxt(s){ return (s||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,''); }
function escapeHtml(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
function estimateDelivery(cityText){
  const norm = normalizeTxt(cityText||'').trim();
  if(!norm) return null;
  const isMain = CIUDADES_PRINCIPALES.some(c => norm.includes(c) || c.includes(norm));
  return isMain ? {min:3,max:5,main:true} : {min:3,max:7,main:false};
}
document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

/* ================= PRECIOS EDITABLES (panel R) ================= */
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'trogui_pies_settings_v1';
let SETTINGS = {price:PRICE, oldPrice:OLD_PRICE, bundlePrice:BUNDLE_PRICE, bundleOldPrice:BUNDLE_OLD_PRICE};
(function loadSettings(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY);
    if(raw){ const s = JSON.parse(raw); SETTINGS = {...SETTINGS, ...s}; }
  }catch(e){}
})();
function renderPrices(){
  const s = SETTINGS;
  document.getElementById('heroPriceOld').textContent = money(s.oldPrice);
  document.getElementById('heroPriceNow').textContent = money(s.price);
  document.getElementById('ofertaOld1').textContent = money(s.oldPrice);
  document.getElementById('ofertaPrice1').textContent = money(s.price);
  document.getElementById('ofertaSave1').textContent = 'Ahorras ' + money(s.oldPrice - s.price);
  document.getElementById('ofertaOld2').textContent = money(s.bundleOldPrice);
  document.getElementById('ofertaPrice2').textContent = money(s.bundlePrice);
  document.getElementById('ofertaSave2').textContent = 'Ahorras ' + money(s.bundleOldPrice - s.bundlePrice) + ' + envío gratis';
  document.getElementById('pkgPrice1').textContent = money(s.price);
  document.getElementById('pkgPrice2').textContent = money(s.bundlePrice);
  document.getElementById('stickyPrice').textContent = money(SELECTED_QTY===2 ? s.bundlePrice : s.price);
}
function saveSettings(newVals){
  SETTINGS = {...SETTINGS, ...newVals};
  try{ localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(SETTINGS)); }catch(e){}
  renderPrices();
}

/* ================= REVEAL ON SCROLL ================= */
const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.classList.add('in');
      if(e.target.classList.contains('feature-list-wrap')) e.target.querySelector('.feature-list')?.classList.add('in');
      io.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
}, {threshold:.15});
revealEls.forEach(el=> io.observe(el));

/* feature-list stagger trigger (parent .reveal contains it) */
document.querySelectorAll('.feature-list').forEach(list=>{
  const io2 = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ list.classList.add('in'); io2.unobserve(list); } });
  }, {threshold:.2});
  io2.observe(list);
});

/* ================= HEADER SHRINK ON SCROLL ================= */
const siteHeader = document.querySelector('.site-header');
window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
  siteHeader.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 30);
}, {passive:true});

/* ================= HERO TILT 3D (desktop) ================= */
const heroCard = document.querySelector('.hero-img-card');
if(heroCard && window.matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches){
  const wrap = heroCard.parentElement;
  wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', (e)=>{
    const r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - .5;
    const y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - .5;
    heroCard.style.transform = `perspective(700px) rotateY(${x*8}deg) rotateX(${-y*8}deg)`;
  });
  wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{ heroCard.style.transform = 'perspective(700px) rotateY(0) rotateX(0)'; });
}

/* ================= TAGS FLOTANTES SOBRE PRODUCTO ================= */
const tagWrap = document.getElementById('productoImgWrap');
if(tagWrap){
  const tagIo = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        ['tagFloat1','tagFloat2','tagFloat3'].forEach((id,i)=>{
          setTimeout(()=> document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('show'), 300 + i*260);
        });
        tagIo.unobserve(tagWrap);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:.4});
  tagIo.observe(tagWrap);
}

/* ================= CONTADOR ANIMADO PARA AHORROS ================= */
function animateCount(el, to, prefix, duration){
  const start = performance.now();
  function step(now){
    const p = Math.min(1, (now-start)/duration);
    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1-p, 3);
    el.textContent = prefix + Math.round(to*eased).toLocaleString('es-CO');
    if(p<1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
function triggerSavingsCount(){
  const s = SETTINGS;
  const save1El = document.getElementById('ofertaSave1');
  const save2El = document.getElementById('ofertaSave2');
  if(save1El && !save1El.dataset.animated){
    save1El.dataset.animated = '1';
    animateCount(save1El, s.oldPrice - s.price, 'Ahorras $', 900);
  }
  if(save2El && !save2El.dataset.animated){
    save2El.dataset.animated = '1';
    const target = s.bundleOldPrice - s.bundlePrice;
    const start = performance.now();
    function step(now){
      const p = Math.min(1, (now-start)/900);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1-p, 3);
      save2El.textContent = 'Ahorras $' + Math.round(target*eased).toLocaleString('es-CO') + ' + envío gratis';
      if(p<1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
}
const ofertaSection = document.getElementById('oferta');
if(ofertaSection){
  const ofertaIo = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ triggerSavingsCount(); ofertaIo.unobserve(ofertaSection); } });
  }, {threshold:.3});
  ofertaIo.observe(ofertaSection);
}

/* ================= URGENCY COUNTDOWN (hasta medianoche hora Bogotá) ================= */
function tickUrgency(){
  const now = new Date();
  const bogotaNow = new Date(now.toLocaleString('en-US', {timeZone:'America/Bogota'}));
  const end = new Date(bogotaNow); end.setHours(23,59,59,999);
  let diff = Math.max(0, end - bogotaNow) / 1000;
  const h = Math.floor(diff/3600), m = Math.floor((diff%3600)/60), s = Math.floor(diff%60);
  document.getElementById('uH').textContent = String(h).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('uM').textContent = String(m).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('uS').textContent = String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
tickUrgency(); setInterval(tickUrgency, 1000);

/* ================= FAQ ================= */
const FAQS = [
  {q:'¿Tiene batería?', a:'Sí. Es recargable mediante USB, incluye su propio cable de carga.'},
  {q:'¿Cuántas velocidades tiene?', a:'Cuenta con 2 velocidades para adaptarse al nivel de cuidado que necesites.'},
  {q:'¿Qué incluye?', a:'1 lima eléctrica, 1 cable de carga USB, 1 rodillo fino y 1 rodillo grueso.'},
  {q:'¿Tiene luz?', a:'Sí, cuenta con luz LED para ayudarte a ver mejor la zona mientras la usas.'},
  {q:'¿Es fácil de limpiar?', a:'Sí, su diseño resistente al agua facilita la limpieza del dispositivo.'},
  {q:'¿Hacen envíos a todo Colombia?', a:'Sí, enviamos a toda Colombia con Interrapidísimo, Envía y Coordinadora.'},
  {q:'¿Puedo pagar cuando reciba?', a:'Sí, ofrecemos pago contra entrega según disponibilidad de cobertura en tu zona.'},
  {q:'¿Tiene garantía?', a:'Sí, cuenta con 30 días de garantía por defectos de fábrica.'}
];
document.getElementById('faqList').innerHTML = FAQS.map((f,i)=>`
  <div class="faq-item" id="faq${i}">
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(${i})"><span>${f.q}</span><span class="plus">+</span></div>
    <div class="faq-a"><div class="faq-a-inner">${f.a}</div></div>
  </div>`).join('');
function toggleFaq(i){ document.getElementById('faq'+i).classList.toggle('open'); }

/* ================= VIDEO MODAL ================= */
function openVideoModal(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'modal-overlay';
  overlay.id = 'videoOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal" style="max-width:360px;">
      <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('videoOverlay')">✕</div>
      <h3>Mira cómo funciona</h3>
      <div class="video-modal-inner">
        <video controls autoplay playsinline src="data:video/mp4;base64,"></video>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
function closeModal(id){ const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.remove(); }

/* ================= PAQUETE / FORMULARIO ================= */
let SELECTED_QTY = 1;
function selectPackage(qty){
  SELECTED_QTY = qty;
  document.getElementById('pkgOpt1').classList.toggle('checked', qty===1);
  document.getElementById('pkgOpt2').classList.toggle('checked', qty===2);
  document.getElementById('stickyPrice').textContent = qty===2 ? money(SETTINGS.bundlePrice) : money(SETTINGS.price);
  document.getElementById('formulario').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
}
function updateDeliveryEstimate(){
  const input = document.getElementById('f_ciudad');
  const box = document.getElementById('deliveryEstimateBox');
  const est = estimateDelivery(input.value);
  box.textContent = est ? `🚚 Entrega estimada: ${est.min} a ${est.max} días hábiles` : '';
}
function toggleEntrega(){
  const casa = document.querySelector('input[name="entrega"][value="casa"]').checked;
  document.getElementById('opt_casa').classList.toggle('checked', casa);
  document.getElementById('opt_oficina').classList.toggle('checked', !casa);
  const dirInput = document.getElementById('f_direccion');
  const dirLabel = document.getElementById('direccionLabel');
  if(casa){ dirInput.required = true; dirInput.placeholder = 'Ej: Cra 45 #12-30, Barrio Laureles'; dirLabel.textContent = 'Dirección completa *'; }
  else { dirInput.required = false; dirInput.placeholder = 'Nombre o ubicación de la oficina (si la conoces)'; dirLabel.textContent = 'Oficina Interrapidísimo (opcional)'; }
}
document.getElementById('orderForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  submitOrder();
});
function readOrders(){ try{ const raw = localStorage.getItem(ORDERS_STORAGE_KEY); return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; }catch(e){ return []; } }
function writeOrders(list){ try{ localStorage.setItem(ORDERS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); }catch(e){} }
function saveOrder(order){
  const list = readOrders(); list.unshift(order); writeOrders(list);
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){
    fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {method:'POST', mode:'no-cors', headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}, body: JSON.stringify({action:'create', order})}).catch(()=>{});
  }
}
function updateOrderStatus(id, status){
  const list = readOrders(); const idx = list.findIndex(o=>o.id===id);
  if(idx>-1){ list[idx].estado = status; writeOrders(list); }
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){
    fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {method:'POST', mode:'no-cors', headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}, body: JSON.stringify({action:'updateStatus', id, status})}).catch(()=>{});
  }
}
async function fetchOrdersOnline(){
  if(!GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL) return null;
  try{ const res = await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL + '?t=' + Date.now()); if(!res.ok) return null; const data = await res.json(); return Array.isArray(data)?data:null; }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function submitOrder(){
  const nombre = document.getElementById('f_nombre').value.trim();
  const telefono = document.getElementById('f_telefono').value.trim();
  const departamento = document.getElementById('f_departamento').value.trim();
  const ciudad = document.getElementById('f_ciudad').value.trim();
  const entrega = document.querySelector('input[name="entrega"]:checked').value;
  const direccion = document.getElementById('f_direccion').value.trim();
  const nota = document.getElementById('f_nota').value.trim();
  const qty = SELECTED_QTY;
  const total = qty===2 ? SETTINGS.bundlePrice : SETTINGS.price;
  const est = estimateDelivery(ciudad);
  const btn = document.getElementById('orderSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = 'Enviando pedido...';
  const now = new Date();
  const fechaLegible = now.toLocaleDateString('es-CO', {day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric', timeZone:'America/Bogota'});
  const horaLegible = now.toLocaleTimeString('es-CO', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', timeZone:'America/Bogota'});
  const order = {
    id: 'PED-' + Date.now(), fecha: now.toISOString(), fechaLegible, horaLegible,
    nombre, telefono, departamento, ciudad, entrega, direccion, nota,
    producto: qty===2 ? PRODUCT_NAME + ' (Pack x2)' : PRODUCT_NAME, productoId: PRODUCT_ID, cantidad: qty,
    precioUnitario: qty===2 ? SETTINGS.bundlePrice/2 : SETTINGS.price, total,
    entregaEstimada: est ? `${est.min}-${est.max} días hábiles` : 'Por confirmar', estado: 'Pendiente'
  };
  saveOrder(order);
  document.getElementById('orderForm').reset();
  selectPackage(1);
  btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '🚀 <span>Quiero recibir mi pedido</span>';
  showOrderConfirmation(order);
}
function showOrderConfirmation(order){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'modal-overlay'; overlay.id = 'orderConfirmOverlay';
  const waMsg = `Hola Trogüi, acabo de hacer un pedido en la página:\n\n*Producto:* ${order.producto}\n*Total:* ${money(order.total)}\n*Nombre:* ${order.nombre}\n*Teléfono:* ${order.telefono}\n*Ciudad:* ${order.ciudad}, ${order.departamento}\n*Entrega:* ${order.entrega==='casa'?'A domicilio':'Oficina Interrapidísimo'}\n${order.direccion?`*Dirección:* ${order.direccion}\n`:''}Pago contra entrega.`;
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal" style="text-align:center;">
      <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('orderConfirmOverlay')">✕</div>
      <div style="width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:#e9f9ee;color:#1a8a4a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px;font-size:1.6rem;">✓</div>
      <h3>¡Pedido recibido!</h3>
      <p class="sub">Guardamos tu pedido y te contactaremos pronto para confirmar la entrega.</p>
      <div style="background:#f7f6f2;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:.85rem;text-align:left;margin-bottom:14px;">
        <div class="order-line"><b>Producto:</b> ${escapeHtml(order.producto)}</div>
        <div class="order-line"><b>Total:</b> ${money(order.total)} (pago contra entrega)</div>
        <div class="order-line"><b>Entrega estimada:</b> ${order.entregaEstimada}</div>
      </div>
      <a class="form-submit" style="text-decoration:none;" href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}" target="_blank"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor"><path d="M16.001 3C9.373 3 4 8.373 4 15c0 2.386.7 4.61 1.902 6.478L4 29l7.72-1.867A11.94 11.94 0 0 0 16 27c6.627 0 12-5.373 12-12S22.628 3 16.001 3zm6.994 17.02c-.29.815-1.44 1.5-2.36 1.694-.633.13-1.46.234-4.24-.906-3.556-1.47-5.84-5.05-6.017-5.285-.176-.235-1.44-1.916-1.44-3.655 0-1.74.91-2.594 1.234-2.95.324-.354.706-.443.94-.443.235 0 .47.003.674.013.216.01.507-.082.793.605.29.7.984 2.418 1.07 2.594.088.176.147.382.03.618-.117.235-.176.382-.35.588-.176.206-.368.46-.526.618-.176.176-.36.367-.156.72.206.353.914 1.51 1.964 2.446 1.35 1.203 2.49 1.576 2.844 1.752.353.176.56.147.766-.088.206-.235.882-1.03 1.117-1.383.235-.353.47-.294.793-.176.324.117 2.06.97 2.412 1.147.353.176.588.264.674.412.088.147.088.85-.204 1.665z"/></svg><span>Avisar también por WhatsApp (opcional)</span></a>
    </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
function showToast(msg){ const t=document.getElementById('toast'); if(!t)return; t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2400); }

/* ================= PANEL DE PEDIDOS (P) ================= */
function openOrdersLogin(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='ordersLoginOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal" style="max-width:320px;">
    <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('ordersLoginOverlay')">✕</div>
    <h3>Pedidos — acceso privado</h3><p class="sub">Ingresa la clave para ver los pedidos.</p>
    <div class="form-row"><input type="password" id="ordersPassInput" placeholder="Clave"></div>
    <button class="form-submit" style="background:var(--black);" onclick="checkOrdersPass()">Entrar</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').focus();
  document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkOrdersPass(); });
}
function checkOrdersPass(){
  if(document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').value === ORDERS_PASSWORD){ closeModal('ordersLoginOverlay'); openOrdersDashboard(); }
  else showToast('Clave incorrecta');
}
async function openOrdersDashboard(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='ordersDashOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal wide">
    <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('ordersDashOverlay')">✕</div>
    <h3>Pedidos — Lima Eléctrica</h3>
    <p class="sub" id="ordersSourceNote">Cargando pedidos...</p>
    <div class="orders-summary" id="ordersSummary"></div>
    <div id="ordersList"><div class="orders-empty">Cargando...</div></div>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  await renderOrdersInto();
}
async function renderOrdersInto(){
  let orders = readOrders();
  let sourceNote = 'Pedidos guardados en este navegador (modo local).';
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){
    const online = await fetchOrdersOnline();
    if(online){ orders = online.filter(o=>o.productoId===PRODUCT_ID || (o.producto||'').includes(PRODUCT_NAME)); sourceNote = 'Pedidos en línea, visibles desde cualquier dispositivo.'; }
    else sourceNote = 'No se pudo conectar en línea, mostrando el respaldo local.';
  }
  const noteEl=document.getElementById('ordersSourceNote'), summaryEl=document.getElementById('ordersSummary'), listEl=document.getElementById('ordersList');
  if(!noteEl||!summaryEl||!listEl) return;
  const pendientes = orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Pendiente').length;
  const resueltos = orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Resuelto').length;
  const entregados = orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Entregado').length;
  noteEl.textContent = sourceNote;
  summaryEl.innerHTML = `<span class="pill">Total: ${orders.length}</span><span class="pill">Pendientes: ${pendientes}</span><span class="pill">Resueltos: ${resueltos}</span><span class="pill">Entregados: ${entregados}</span><span class="pill" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="renderOrdersInto()">↻ Actualizar</span>`;
  listEl.innerHTML = orders.length ? orders.map(orderCardHtml).join('') : '<div class="orders-empty">Todavía no hay pedidos registrados.</div>';
}
function orderCardHtml(o){
  const fecha = new Date(o.fecha);
  const fechaStr = isNaN(fecha) ? '' : fecha.toLocaleDateString('es-CO', {day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric'});
  const horaStr = isNaN(fecha) ? '' : fecha.toLocaleTimeString('es-CO', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
  const estadoClass = (o.estado||'Pendiente').toLowerCase();
  return `<div class="order-card">
    <div class="order-card-head"><div><b>${escapeHtml(o.nombre)}</b><div style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--gray);">📅 ${fechaStr} · 🕒 ${horaStr}</div></div><span class="order-status ${estadoClass}">${escapeHtml(o.estado)}</span></div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Producto:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.producto)} — ${money(o.total)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Teléfono:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.telefono)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Ubicación:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.ciudad)}, ${escapeHtml(o.departamento)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Entrega:</b> ${o.entrega==='casa'?'A domicilio':'Oficina Interrapidísimo'}${o.direccion?' — '+escapeHtml(o.direccion):''}</div>
    ${o.nota?`<div class="order-line"><b>Nota:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.nota)}</div>`:''}
    <div class="order-actions">
      <button class="${o.estado==='Pendiente'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Pendiente')">Pendiente</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Resuelto'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Resuelto')">Resuelto</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Entregado'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Entregado')">Entregado</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Cancelado'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Cancelado')">Cancelado</button>
    </div></div>`;
}
function setOrderStatus(id, status){ updateOrderStatus(id, status); renderOrdersInto(); showToast('Estado actualizado a: '+status); }

/* ================= PANEL ADMIN LIGERO (R) ================= */
function openAdminLogin(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='adminLoginOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal" style="max-width:320px;">
    <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('adminLoginOverlay')">✕</div>
    <h3>Panel de administración</h3><p class="sub">Ingresa la clave para editar el precio.</p>
    <div class="form-row"><input type="password" id="adminPassInput" placeholder="Clave"></div>
    <button class="form-submit" style="background:var(--black);" onclick="checkAdminPass()">Entrar</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('adminPassInput').focus();
  document.getElementById('adminPassInput').addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkAdminPass(); });
}
function checkAdminPass(){
  if(document.getElementById('adminPassInput').value === ADMIN_PASS){ closeModal('adminLoginOverlay'); openAdminPanel(); }
  else showToast('Clave incorrecta');
}
function openAdminPanel(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='adminPanelOverlay';
  const s = SETTINGS;
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('adminPanelOverlay')">✕</div>
    <h3>Editar precios</h3><p class="sub">Estos cambios se guardan en este navegador y se ven en toda la página al instante.</p>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio 1 unidad</label><input type="number" id="e_price" value="${s.price}"></div>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio antes (tachado) — 1 unidad</label><input type="number" id="e_oldprice" value="${s.oldPrice}"></div>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio Pack x2</label><input type="number" id="e_bundleprice" value="${s.bundlePrice}"></div>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio antes (tachado) — Pack x2</label><input type="number" id="e_bundleold" value="${s.bundleOldPrice}"></div>
    <button class="form-submit" style="background:var(--orange);" onclick="saveAdminPrices()">Guardar cambios</button>
    <button class="form-submit" style="background:var(--black);margin-top:8px;" onclick="resetAdminPrices()">Restablecer precios originales</button>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
function saveAdminPrices(){
  const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_price').value)||0;
  const oldPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_oldprice').value)||0;
  const bundlePrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_bundleprice').value)||0;
  const bundleOldPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_bundleold').value)||0;
  saveSettings({price, oldPrice, bundlePrice, bundleOldPrice});
  closeModal('adminPanelOverlay');
  showToast('Precios actualizados');
}
function resetAdminPrices(){
  try{ localStorage.removeItem(SETTINGS_KEY); }catch(e){}
  SETTINGS = {price:PRICE, oldPrice:OLD_PRICE, bundlePrice:BUNDLE_PRICE, bundleOldPrice:BUNDLE_OLD_PRICE};
  renderPrices();
  closeModal('adminPanelOverlay');
  showToast('Precios restablecidos');
}
renderPrices();

/* ================= NOTIFICACIONES DE COMPRA (social proof) ================= */
const NOMBRES_NOTIF = ['María Restrepo','Laura Gómez','Camila Torres','Valentina Ríos','Andrea Muñoz',
'Juliana Cárdenas','Paula Salazar','Daniela Ospina','Natalia Suárez','Carolina Duque','Mónica Bedoya',
'Sara Moreno','Yesenia Villalba','Karen Bonilla','Estefanía López','Lina Ocampo','Diana Herrera','Alejandra Puentes'];
const CIUDADES_NOTIF = [
  {c:'Ibagué', d:'Tolima'}, {c:'Bogotá', d:'Cundinamarca'}, {c:'Medellín', d:'Antioquia'},
  {c:'Cali', d:'Valle del Cauca'}, {c:'Barranquilla', d:'Atlántico'}, {c:'Bucaramanga', d:'Santander'},
  {c:'Pereira', d:'Risaralda'}, {c:'Manizales', d:'Caldas'}, {c:'Cúcuta', d:'Norte de Santander'},
  {c:'Villavicencio', d:'Meta'}, {c:'Santa Marta', d:'Magdalena'}, {c:'Neiva', d:'Huila'},
  {c:'Armenia', d:'Quindío'}, {c:'Popayán', d:'Cauca'}, {c:'Valledupar', d:'Cesar'},
  {c:'Montería', d:'Córdoba'}, {c:'Sincelejo', d:'Sucre'}, {c:'Tunja', d:'Boyacá'},
  {c:'Quibdó', d:'Chocó'}, {c:'Riohacha', d:'La Guajira'}
];
function pushPurchaseNotif(){
  const host = document.getElementById('notifHost');
  if(!host) return;
  const name = NOMBRES_NOTIF[Math.floor(Math.random()*NOMBRES_NOTIF.length)];
  const loc = CIUDADES_NOTIF[Math.floor(Math.random()*CIUDADES_NOTIF.length)];
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'notif-toast';
  el.innerHTML = `<span class="notif-avatar">${name.charAt(0)}</span><span><b>${name}</b> hizo un pedido para ${loc.c}, ${loc.d}</span>`;
  host.appendChild(el);
  requestAnimationFrame(()=> el.classList.add('show'));
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(()=> el.remove(), 400); }, 4800);
}
function startPurchaseNotifs(){
  setTimeout(()=> pushPurchaseNotif(), 6000);
  const loop = ()=>{
    const delay = 14000 + Math.random()*12000;
    setTimeout(()=>{ pushPurchaseNotif(); loop(); }, delay);
  };
  setTimeout(loop, 16000);
}
startPurchaseNotifs();

</script>
</body>
</html>
